announcing_notice_sha256.description: Optional digest of a PublicNotice envelope that announced this snapshot or parity failure.

body_evidence.description: Optional pointer to detached raw response bytes (use sparingly; hashes-first).

body_sha256.description: Digest of raw response body bytes (works even for error pages/WAF blocks).

envelope_payload_sha256.description: When parseable, the served envelope.payload_digest (recomputed digest preferred).

envelope_tbs_sha256.description: When parseable, the served envelope.tbs_digest (recomputed digest preferred).

fetched_at.description: When this channel fetch was performed (best effort).

http_status.description: HTTP status code (0 permitted for non-HTTP failures).

url.description: Fetch location used for this observation.

observed_at.description: When this snapshot was produced (best effort).

previous_snapshot_sha256.description: Optional digest of the prior snapshot payload in this series (anti-rollback / anti-rewrite).

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier for this snapshot series (updates may chain via previous_snapshot_sha256).

snapshot_version.description: Schema version of this snapshot payload.

expected_envelope_kind.description: Optional expected EvidenceEnvelope.kind when the surface serves an envelope (e.g., hfv.public.notice_feed).

stable_target.description: Stable path/identifier for the surface (e.g., /notices/feed/latest.json or /status/).

surface_kind.description: Named public surface being checked (keep the vocabulary small; add via change control).
